text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Well then— shall we make a toast, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...First of all, thank you for all your 
hard work over these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To celebrate successfully running through 
three precious years together with <chrname>... 
Ryoka Tsurugi invited me out for a meal 
today.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Elfie and I watched <chrname>-san's recent race 
together. ……Truly, it moved my heart 
deeply.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
They must be fighting in a harsh world 
unimaginable to a mere fan like me.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yet, precisely because of that— we cannot 
help but be utterly captivated by the way 
you run, by every step you take.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
As one who aspires to create new 
entertainment, witnessing its absolute 
pinnacle…… makes me feel humbled and 
re-energized once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While feeling a bit bashful at the 
heartfelt praise... we let our memories 
blossom into conversation about the days 
we'd raced through together to get here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And while doing so—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that race...! I see. It was a 
momentous battle for both you and <chrname>, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Talking like this makes me want 
to watch it all over again. It truly was a 
magnificent race, after all—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...If I recall correctly, that race video 
was uploaded to the official URA UmaTube 
channel, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case... Trainer. If you'd 
like――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Care to join me for round two?

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Now, 200 meters remaining! Which 
Umamusume will seize the crown?! In the 
lead is――!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Phew…… I was completely captivated by 
that……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agreeing wholeheartedly, I tap the screen 
of my phone connected to the monitor and 
pause the race footage that was playing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away that I accidentally 
cheered out loud... Thank goodness I was 
in a soundproofed private room at an 
internet cafe.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Every race is so full of drama... Fufu, 
after hearing all those stories, they seem 
to shine even brighter now.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Among them, the final race is truly 
something special. Would you call it the 
crowning achievement, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Rightââ" I nod in agreement, then a 
thought strikes me, and I decide to ask.
choice_data_list:
What do you consider your best race, Ms. 
Tsurugi?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ! …………I suppose... so.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Would you mind if I switched the phone 
connection?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it hasn't been uploaded to 
the URA's official channel. ...So this is 
from my own personal recorded footage, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Number 11, Sonon Elfie!! Thanks for all 
your support, always!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Today... will be my final race!! Let's do 
thisss!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ........!! Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yes—that's right, right here.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
600 meters remaining... After 
front-running with everything she had, 
Elfie was finally caught by the pack 
behind her.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrrrrrgh...! 
Oooooryaaaaaaaahhhhhââ!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Still, you hang on. ...You just keep 
hanging on! Even if one passes you, even 
if two pass you, you still fight with 
everything you've got to—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...The result was 7th place. However—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It was my best race. Irreplaceable... and 
truly mine.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm... really glad I could open up to you 
today.
